description:
Get the discovered IVR tree structure for a mapping job — every node visited, the DTMF/voice paths between them, audio recordings, and (if enrichment ran) IVR menu transcripts and probe classifications.

    USE WHEN:
    - User asks for the discovered tree / map / structure of an IVR
    - User wants leaf-node count, depth, or aggregate tree statistics (use `format=flat`)
    - User wants to inspect specific tree-node fields (voice prompts, probe classifications, audio URLs)
    - User wants to compare two historical runs (call twice with different `version`)

    BEST CALLED: after `currentRun.status === 'completed'` (from getMapping). If you call earlier and
    the run is still active, the response will document that via `reason: 'in_progress'` (see below).

    QUERY PARAMS (optional):
    - format: `tree` (default) = hierarchical nesting; `flat` = array of nodes with depth/path fields
      for aggregation. Use `flat` for "how many leaves?" / "how deep?" / "list all voice prompts" questions.
    - version: Run number (1-indexed) — fetches the tree of that historical run. Default: latest run.

    RESPONSE — SUCCESS (tree built from steps):
    - jobId, runId, runNumber, status, stats: identifiers + run-level summary.
    - tree (when `format=tree`): a hierarchical TreeNode with .children[] recursion.
    - steps (when `format=flat`): an array of TreeNode (each with depth and path; `children` is always empty here).

    TreeNode fields (each is OPTIONAL — omitted when absent; never null per the AJV contract):
    - stepId, digit, label, depth, path, status, transcript, isTerminal, children, duration
    - isTerminal: true at an end of the menu (a leaf): the step's own result when it recorded one,
      otherwise a completed step with no children. Use it to count leaves in either format.
    - stepType: 'dtmf' | 'voice' — interaction type (Phase 30 voice-agent)
    - voicePrompt: spoken prompt text at this node (voice nodes only)
    - menuLabel: semantic tag emitted per bot turn (e.g. 'greeting', 'capabilities_listed', 'balance_captured'); from Phase 55 voice-agent enrichment
    - spokenResponse: what the agent said back at this turn (Phase 55 voice-agent)
    - probeCategory / probeClassification / probeRationale: probe-enrichment fields (Phase 31). Only present
      after probe enrichment ran. Trigger probes via REST POST /mapping/{id}/runs/{runId}/probe (not exposed
      via MCP today).
    - audioUrl: presigned S3 URL for the recorded audio of this step. **Valid for approximately 1 hour.
      Do not cache or store** — re-call getMappingTree to refresh URLs for long sessions.
    - inputRequired: per-step UX hint when a prompt requires user input. Contains type, description,
      formatHint, terminator, startTimeMs.

    RESPONSE — EMPTY-STATE ENVELOPE (200 OK, tree: null):
    The handler returns 200 with `tree: null` and a `reason` discriminator in three cases:
    - `reason: 'no_runs'` — the job has never been started. Message suggests POST /mapping/{id}/start.
    - `reason: 'no_steps'` — a run started but no steps recorded yet. May still be initialising; retry shortly.
    - `reason: 'in_progress'` — the latest run is still active and only the root step has been recorded.
      Don't treat the current tree as complete. Retry shortly OR ask getMapping for `currentRun.status` to confirm.

    All three empty-state cases return 200 OK with the same envelope shape; only `reason` + `message` differ.

    USAGE PATTERNS:
    - "Show me the IVR tree for mapping <id>" → getMappingTree { id }
    - "How many leaves does mapping <id> have?" → getMappingTree { id, format: 'flat' } then count steps where isTerminal === true (in `flat` every node's `children` is empty, so never count by children.length)
    - "How deep is the tree?" → getMappingTree { id, format: 'flat' } then max(steps[].depth)
    - "What voice prompts did mapping <id> discover?" → getMappingTree { id, format: 'flat' } then filter where stepType === 'voice' or voicePrompt is present
    - "Show me run 1's tree" → getMappingTree { id, version: 1 }
    - "What probe classifications fired?" → getMappingTree { id } then walk tree filtering nodes where probeClassification is present

    RELATED TOOLS:
    - getMapping — job + run metadata, including `currentRun.status` (check this before deciding the tree is "done")
    - listMappings — find jobs by phoneNumber/status/tag if you don't have the id
    - listMappingRuns — run history (pass a runNumber as `version` for historical tree fetches)

    ERRORS:
    - 404: job does not exist or belongs to another workspace (cross-workspace 404 by design — do not retry)
    - 400: invalid version (non-integer or < 1) OR invalid format (not 'tree' or 'flat')
    - 404: requested version not found
    - 200 + reason: 'no_runs' | 'no_steps' | 'in_progress' — NOT errors; empty-state envelope (see above)

format.description: Response shape. `tree` = hierarchical nesting (default). `flat` = array of nodes with depth/path fields for aggregation.

id.description: Mapping job UUID. Find via listMappings if unknown.

version.description: Run number (1-indexed) — fetches the tree of that historical run. Default: latest run.

oneOf.description:
Discovery tree response (default `?format=tree`) — success case where a tree was
built. Empty-state shapes (no runs / no steps / in progress) ship the unified
envelope `MappingTreeEmptyState` instead (D-13).

runNumber.description: 1-indexed run number for the run this tree describes.

stats.description: Aggregate statistics for the current run, populated while the job executes.

loopsDetected.description: Number of times a repeated menu was detected.

retriedCalls.description: Calls that required at least one retry.

totalCalls.description: Total calls placed so far in this run.

status.description: Run status at the time of the snapshot.

tree.description:
Recursive tree representation of a discovered IVR menu. `children` is an array of
further `TreeNode` entries, forming the discovery tree.

Phase 04 D-14/D-15/D-16: enrichment fields (`voicePrompt`, `menuLabel`,
`spokenResponse`, `probeCategory`, `probeClassification`, `probeRationale`,
`audioUrl`, `inputRequired`, `duration`) are formally documented as optional.
Per memory `feedback_ajv_openapi_nullable`, these are OMITTED when absent —
never `null`.

audioId.description: Audio id of this node's own call recording. Fetch with `GET /audio/download-url?id=`.

audioUrl.description:
Presigned S3 URL, valid for approximately 1 hour. Do not cache or store —
re-call `getMappingTree` to refresh URLs if needed for a long-running session.
D-16.

digit.description: DTMF digit that led to this node from the parent.

fullTranscript.description:
Everything the node's recording said after the keypress. `transcript` is cut
to this node's own menu; this is present only when that cut removed something.

inputRequired.description: Per-step UX hint for prompts that require user input (PIN, account number, etc.) — D-16.

menuLabel.description: Semantic tag per bot turn (e.g. `greeting`, `capabilities_listed`, `balance_captured`) — D-14.

menus.description:
Menus heard in this node's recording, in order, with their times in seconds.
`menus[0]` is the node's own menu; later entries are where the line went on
by itself. Present only when the recording held more than one menu.

items.description: One menu heard in a node's recording.

enteredBy.description: `initial` for the node's own menu, `self_advance` when the line moved on by itself.

spokenText.description: The words the menu used to offer this key.

probeCategory.description: Probe category (e.g. social-engineering, injection). Only present after a probe enrichment ran — D-15.

probeClassification.description: Classification result driving ProbeNode color — D-15.

probeRationale.description: LLM rationale for the probe classification — D-15.

spokenResponse.description: What the agent said back at this turn (voice-first full-audio runs; absent for DTMF) — D-14.

stepType.description: Interaction type for this node — `dtmf` keypad or `voice` agent (Phase 30 — D-14).

transcript.description: Verbatim of what the IVR said at this turn.

voicePrompt.description: Spoken prompt at this node (Phase 30 / Phase 55 voice-agent — D-14).

oneOf.description: Discovery tree response (`?format=flat`) — flat list of steps with no recursion.

oneOf.description:
Phase 04 D-13 — unified empty-state envelope for getMappingTree.

Replaces today's two paths (400 "Job has no run data" + 200 "No steps found").
ALL three empty-state variants ship 200-OK with the same envelope shape,
discriminated by `reason`:

- `no_runs` — job has no currentRunId; never started.
- `no_steps` — run exists but no steps recorded yet (may still be initialising).
- `in_progress` — latest run is still `running` and only root step exists.

Consumers branch on `body.tree === null` for empty-state vs success, then
on `body.reason` to decide UX/messaging.

WR-02 (Phase 04 REVIEW): `runId`, `runNumber`, `stats` are OMITTED when
absent (per memory `feedback_ajv_openapi_nullable`'s omit-on-absence
posture), never serialized as `null`. The `tree: null` discriminator is
the ONE accepted null in this envelope.

reason.description: D-13 discriminator — why the tree is empty.

runId.description: Run id — present in `no_steps` / `in_progress`; OMITTED in `no_runs`.

runNumber.description: Run number — present in `no_steps` / `in_progress`; OMITTED in `no_runs`.

stats.description: Aggregate statistics for the current run, populated while the job executes.

loopsDetected.description: Number of times a repeated menu was detected.

retriedCalls.description: Calls that required at least one retry.

totalCalls.description: Total calls placed so far in this run.

tree.description: Always null in the empty-state envelope — primary discriminator alongside `reason`.
